label: Shifted naturalistic arche from water to fire and flux
description: Heraclitus of Ephesus adopted Thales of Miletus's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Thales of Miletus's perspective to Heraclitus of Ephesus's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Pre-Socratic era.
